text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A glittering array of classmates and 
world-class powerhouses have gathered for 
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the one who overcame them all and 
claimed victory in the fierce battle was 
the timid yet magnificent Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the unsparing applause and cheers, 
she roared with all her heart— that it was 
okay to hold wishes, and okay to chase 
after dreams—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carried over the broadcast, that shout 
gave a push to Shine Praise, who was far 
away and terrified of undergoing a 
difficult surgery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. The phone in the 
trainer's office rang, delivering the news 
that her childhood friend's surgery was a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, "strong" and "great" took 
a break. She gently stroked the sobbing 
Cheval Grand's back, again and again.
